messages:
raj: Heads up — customer reported a billing mismatch for streaming requests. Looks like some retries never show up in the ledger.
maria: Do you have the trace IDs? could be the 'quiet retry' we talked about last week. @kevin any idea?
raj: Pasting a trimmed log from the edge:
```
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z stream_id=abc123 event=chunk_sent tokens=8 trace=trace-2026-03-3345
2026-03-20T14:12:04Z stream_id=abc123 event=socket_disconnect reason=network
2026-03-20T14:12:04Z stream_id=abc123 event=socket_resume silent=true tokens=12 trace=trace-2026-03-3345
```
kevin: Hmm. `silent=true` means the resume path didn't go through the usual toolcall handshake. billing logic expects a toolcall boundary to mark token attribution so replayed tokens become provisional. If that's skipped, tokens are never flagged for provisional reconciliation.
anna: Our telemetry currently tags retries with header `x-retry: true` on the HTTP path. Websocket reconnects don't set that header — so they're invisible to the reconciler.
maria: Two parts: 1) emit a deterministic replay tag on resume events (so ledger can provisional-credit), 2) surface provisional vs confirmed in the Console request inspector (support cannot tell which tokens are provisional right now). Metric idea: `stream.replay_unattributed_tokens` to catch rate.
raj: Proposal: on socket resume the server should emit an event blob like:
```
{"event":"resume","replay_origin":"socket_reconnect","tokens":"12","session_id":"s-abc123","trace_id":"trace-2026-03-3345"}
```
then the billing pipeline can mark those tokens as `provisional=replay` until confirmed by final ack.
kevin: that seems reasonable. We'll need a short-lived ledger flag and a reconciliation job to convert provisional -> confirmed or refund if double-counted. Also update internal API: `POST /v1/stream/events` accept `replay_origin` enum.
anna: I can pick up the Console change to show provisional badges and an explain tooltip. I'll add a tiny endpoint to fetch `provisional` state per session for the inspector.
infra-bot: deploy: canary r-2.4.3 -> success :white_check_mark:
kevin: sg. I'll add the meter tag (`replay_origin`) to the tracing pipeline and wire up a prom counter. Who wants to own the reconciler change?
anna: I'll own the Console + reconciler UI integration, will coordinate with billing for the ledger change.
maria: Nice. Let's add a short postmortem-style blurb to the runbook if this shows up in prod: how to identify, query traces, and revert canary. :thumbsup:
raj: Thanks — filing a small RFC and a support doc. Keeping an eye on the canary metrics now.
